acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves that Proofloom rejects under-specified task packets and unsafe dependency state; it does not approve the tasks themselves.
evidenceRequired: Schema and validator tests reject missing dependencies, acceptance evidence, authority boundaries, and verification requirements.
Backlog audit tests reject cycles, unknown dependencies, and ACTIVE work whose dependencies are not completed.

completionCriteria: Every non-terminal task packet uses the current governed schema and explicitly declares dependencies, completion criteria, required verification, authority boundaries, acceptance evidence, decision authority, and claim boundary.
High and critical risk tasks require a human acceptance decision.
A schemaVersion 3 task cannot become COMPLETED without an ACCEPTED decision, named authority, and acceptance evidence.
The backlog audit rejects unknown dependencies, dependency cycles, and ACTIVE work with incomplete dependencies.
Historical schemaVersion 2 terminal records remain readable without weakening governance for new or open work.
nonObjectives: Do not automatically approve, activate, execute, or complete drafted work.
Do not use wording heuristics as a substitute for structured evidence and human authority.
Do not rewrite historical terminal records merely to make the new policy appear retroactive.
objective: Make backlog drafting, dependencies, acceptance evidence, and terminal decisions machine-governed before trust work can execute.
title: Govern backlog authoring, dependencies, and acceptance
